name: PAT_REVIEW_DATA
description: Table contains patient entered clinical data review from Welcome Kiosk and MyChart.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number for this contact. This number is unique across all patient encounters in your system. If you use IntraConnect this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique, internal contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of the contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: PAT_REVIEW_ELG_C_YN
columns.description: Patient allergies reviewed by the patient. The response to the prompt, "do you have any additional allergies?"

columns.name: PAT_REVIEW_ORD_C_YN
columns.description: Patient medications reviewed by the patient. The response to the prompt, "do you have any additional medications?"

columns.name: PAT_REVIEW_LPL_C_YN
columns.description: Patient problems reviewed by the patient. The response to the prompt, "do you have any additional problems?"

columns.name: PAT_ALG_RVW_INFO_C_NAME
columns.description: The patient's response to the "are these allergies correct?" question in Welcome.
entries: Don't know details of health issues
Exited before health issues were verified

columns.name: PAT_MED_RVW_INFO_C_NAME
columns.description: The patient's response to the "are these medications correct?" question in Welcome.

columns.name: PAT_PROB_RVW_INFO_C_NAME
columns.description: The patient's response to the "are these problems correct?" question in Welcome.

columns.name: ENC_PHR_VERIF_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The last instant that a patient's encounter pharmacy was updated or verified.

columns.name: ENC_PHR_VERIF_AUDIT_CONTEXT_C_NAME
columns.description: The context of the last update or verification of a patient's encounter pharmacy.

columns.name: ENC_PHR_VERIF_USER_ID
columns.description: The user that last updated or verified the patient's encounter pharmacy.

columns.name: ENC_PHR_VERIF_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: ENC_PHR_VERIF_MYPT_ID
columns.description: The MyChart user that last updated or verified the patient's encounter pharmacy.
